title: What kind of food do you like?
setting: 你正在和朋友聊各自喜欢的食物。对方想知道你的饮食偏好，你可以选择最符合自己的方式回答。

turns.text: What kind of food do you like?

turns.prompt: 朋友问你喜欢吃什么，你会怎么回答？

choices.text: I enjoy trying food from different countries.

feedback.naturalExpression: I enjoy trying food from different countries.
feedback.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 trying，表示喜欢尝试来自不同国家的食物。

choices.text: I like all kinds of food.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like all kinds of food.
feedback.explanation: all kinds of food 表示各种各样的食物，是谈论广泛饮食喜好的常用说法。

choices.text: I enjoy to try different country foods.

feedback.naturalExpression: I enjoy trying food from different countries.
feedback.explanation: enjoy 后面通常接动名词，因此应说 enjoy trying；food from different countries 也比 different country foods 更自然。

choices.text: I like Chinese food, especially Sichuan food. I love spicy food.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like Chinese food, especially Sichuan food. I love spicy food.
feedback.explanation: 先说整体偏好，再用 especially 补充具体菜系，表达清楚自然；spicy food 表示辣味食物。

choices.text: I like all kinds of food, but I especially like Asian food.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like all kinds of food, but I especially like Asian food.
feedback.explanation: but I especially like... 可以在广泛喜好之后突出自己最喜欢的一类食物。

choices.text: I’m not really picky. I’ll eat pretty much anything.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not really picky. I’ll eat pretty much anything.
feedback.explanation: not picky 表示不挑食；pretty much anything 表示基本上什么都吃，是很自然的日常口语。
be really into... 表示非常喜欢或对某事很感兴趣，比单纯的 like 语气更强。
seafood 是海鲜的总称，使用 especially fish 可以进一步说明自己特别喜欢鱼类。

choices.text: I’m really into Japanese and Korean food.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m really into Japanese and Korean food.
feedback.explanation: be really into... 很适合表达近期或长期都很喜欢某类食物；并列两种菜系时直接使用 and 连接。

turns.text: That sounds good. I especially like Thai food, but I’m always happy to try something new.
